selection_rationale: Curated 12-pathway validation panel distinguishing graph reachability from functional plausibility, sensory-domain biological plausibility, and transduction validity. Explicitly separates TRANSDUCTION_LIMITED visual pathways from genuine connectome-derived dynamical silence.

pathways.biological_plausibility: HIGH - Left front leg mechanosensory obstacle encounter drives ipsilateral steering away from obstacle or postural evasion.
pathways.transduction_validity: VALID - Physical mechanosensory receptor array faithfully maps to leg tactile afferents.

pathways.biological_plausibility: HIGH - Bilateral mirror of Left T1 tactile steering; obstacle on right leg expected to drive right steering.
pathways.transduction_validity: VALID - Physical mechanosensory receptor array faithfully mapped.

pathways.biological_plausibility: HIGH - Acoustic startle / vibration transduced by Johnston organ recruits Giant Fiber escape jump.
pathways.transduction_validity: VALID - Johnston organ auditory Johnston organ receptor array.

pathways.biological_plausibility: HIGH - Bilateral homologue of left acoustic escape startle.
pathways.transduction_validity: VALID - Johnston organ right auditory receptor array.

pathways.biological_plausibility: MODERATE_HIGH - Direct noxious / sudden mechanosensory strike to prothoracic leg can recruit jump escape in diptera.
VERY_HIGH - Mechanosensory dust/debris on front leg triggers anterior grooming sweep (Seeds et al. 2014).
pathways.transduction_validity: VALID - Leg tactile bristle sensory array.

pathways.biological_plausibility: VERY_HIGH - Right leg mechanosensory irritation triggers anterior grooming.
pathways.transduction_validity: VALID - Leg tactile bristle sensory array.

pathways.biological_plausibility: HIGH - Asymmetric antennal wind displacement drives corrective yaw steering.
pathways.transduction_validity: VALID - Johnston organ mechanosensory wind receptor array.
VALID - Johnston organ mechanosensory wind receptor array.

pathways.biological_plausibility: VERY_HIGH in vivo - Looming visual expansion triggers DNp02/04 takeoff (Williamson et al. 2018).
pathways.transduction_validity: INADEQUATE - Static photoreceptor array lacking optical flow / looming expansion filters. Excluded from primary connectome motor silence claims.

pathways.biological_plausibility: VERY_HIGH in vivo - Looming shadow triggers Giant Fiber jump (Ache et al. 2019).
pathways.transduction_validity: INADEQUATE - Flat photoreceptor drive lacks lobula columnar (LC4/LPLC2) feature extraction.
